items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: You know who Rudy VanGelder is?

ctx.x: Yeah. I love those things you do. A date like this, would there be any rehearsal?
I mean you know some of the best records have been made in six hours. And if you had a rehearsal the day before that was a luxury. Most of the time there wasn’t. You know who Rudy VanGelder is?
